gameLocalization.note: Names follow paired Canto IX part 3 records. The packaging skill aliases and Great Brother tattoo spacing are resolved by game IDs. The later Rule Violation uses Matthias skill 132711 rather than the similarly named rematch skill 134105. Purple Breath is a shortened reference to assist skill 40001004. NPC assistance conditions, temporary Turn 2 debuffs, ordinary Counters, automatic follow-ups, unknown ending threshold, and distinctions from 9-44 are retained.

lead.text: Leave Matthias to Moses, Ezra, and Vespa while the three Sinners focus on Kira. Do not assign Defense Skills or clashes to attacks meant for Assist Defense, and avoid needlessly triggering the Nursefather's Counter.

listLead.text: Leave the Nursefather to the allied NPC while 3 Sinners focus on the Apprentice. Do not assign defense or Clashes to attacks intended for Assist Defense, and avoid needlessly triggering the Nursefather's Counter.

statNote.text: Only Yi Sang, Don Quixote, and Hong Lu deploy; each has two skill slots. Enemy tables show base values, with NPC debuffs handled separately. Matthias triggers the ending event below a certain HP threshold, whose exact value is unconfirmed. Do not apply 9-44's final escort conditions or 701 HP threshold here. Check the initial shared Ampule count on screen.

priorities.0.text: Focus on Kira and leave Matthias to the NPCs.

priorities.1.text: Do not equip Defense Skills on targets of unopposed attacks left to assistance.

priorities.2.text: After defeating Kira, keep checking Counters and tattoos; avoid unnecessary attacks.

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: His ordinary Counter and its Great Brother tattoo reuse are dangerous. Have Sinners attack only Kira and leave damage against Matthias to the NPCs.

troubleshooting.1.symptom.text: Assistance fails to activate and Sinners take heavy damage

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: Ezra and Vespa's Assist Defense intercepts unopposed attacks against allies with no Defense Skills equipped. Do not clash with an attack left to them or equip Defense Skills in any other slot of its target. Also check that the NPC has Assist Defense equipped.

troubleshooting.2.symptom.text: Kira's opening attack consumes an Ampule

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: Losing to “Totally Badass Ass-kicking” is especially dangerous. Win the opening clash with a strong regular skill or E.G.O. Moses's Plus Coin Drop makes clashes easier from Turn 2 onward.

units.0.notes.0.text: Has Sealed Sword. Even skills with the same name change Power and effects as its stage changes.

units.0.notes.1.text: Mainly handled by the NPCs. Progresses to an event below a certain HP threshold; Sinners do not need to reduce HP to 0.

units.0.notes.2.text: One unidentified passive is omitted rather than assigning it an unconfirmed effect.

units.1.notes.0.text: Moses's Purple Breath applies 3 Plus Coin Drop from Turn 2 for five turns. This temporary effect is not included in the table.

units.1.notes.1.text: Gains strength through I Got Praised!, Thermal Blades, and tattoos. Check current clash predictions and Counters while focusing attacks.

phases.0.title.text: Bring healing to protect the three required Sinners and the NPCs

phases.0.steps.0.text: Recommended Lv. 60. Level Yi Sang, Don Quixote, and Hong Lu. Each has two slots, so divide attacks against Kira and healing duties.

phases.0.steps.1.text: Moses, Ezra, and Vespa fight alongside you. You lose if any NPC dies, so do not spend all shared Ampules on Sinners.

phases.0.steps.2.text: Kira is vulnerable to Pierce. Consider affinity, but also save a way to beat the opening “Totally Badass Ass-kicking”.

phases.1.steps.0.text: All three Sinners focus on Kira. Spare attacks against Matthias trigger his ordinary Counter; use spare actions for healing or necessary defense instead.

phases.1.steps.1.text: Stop the opening “Totally Badass Ass-kicking” with a strong skill. Watch for Coin reuse at 4 or more I Got Praised! and for additional damage.

phases.1.steps.2.text: Purple Breath applies 3 Plus Coin Drop to Kira on Turn 2. Check the effect and remaining duration, then use improved clash predictions to Stagger and defeat her.

phases.2.title.text: Maintain the conditions for NPC assistance

phases.2.steps.0.text: Check that Ezra or Vespa has Assist Defense equipped. Do not assign a Sinner to clash with an attack left to them; keep it unopposed.

phases.2.steps.1.text: Do not equip Defense Skills on the targeted Sinner. Defense in another slot of the same Sinner also breaks the condition, so use attacks against Kira or healing instead.

phases.2.steps.2.text: Even if a Sinner is predicted to win, taking over the clash changes assistance and Counter management. Generally leave it to the NPCs and focus on Kira.

phases.3.title.text: Do not count event attacks as extra selectable skills

phases.3.steps.0.text: Don Quixote performs an automatic follow-up on Turn 2, and Yi Sang on Turn 5. These are separate from skills selected from your hand; there is no need to prepare resources as for an ordinary E.G.O use.

phases.3.steps.1.text: Don Quixote's automatic follow-up does not trigger Matthias's Counter. This does not mean regular attacks are safe too.

phases.4.title.text: Wait for the NPCs to finish without adding Counters

phases.4.steps.0.text: Once Kira is defeated, everyone does not need to attack Matthias. Hold attacks unless he has no Counter and can be attacked safely. Having no tattoos does not remove the Counter itself.

phases.4.steps.1.text: On turns when NPCs use Assist Defense, do not cancel their assistance by equipping Defense Skills. Check targets and available assistance, then choose healing or withholding attacks as appropriate.

phases.4.steps.2.text: The battle ends through an event below a certain HP threshold. Guarding Moses for three turns in 9-44 is not this battle's ending condition.

passives.0.effect.text:
On Clash Win, gain 1 Check This Out, Kiddo!

On skill hit, gain 1 Check This Out, Kiddo! (once per skill; destroyed Coins do not grant it).

If the first skill used this turn wins a clash, gain 1 additional Check This Out, Kiddo! and give that skill +1 Coin Power.

passives.0.condition.text: Clash wins and hits with undestroyed Coins

passives.0.response.text: The NPCs handle Matthias's buffs too. Do not provoke extra Counters with careless Sinner attacks.

passives.1.effect.text:
After taking damage from skills twice, gain 1 The Middle - Grudge and lose 1 Check This Out, Kiddo! (damage instances accumulate).

At maximum The Middle - Grudge, use a powerful attack.

At Turn End, if HP is below 80%, 60%, or 40%, gain The Middle - Grudge up to its maximum.

passives.1.condition.text: Two instances of skill damage; HP thresholds

passives.1.response.text: Additional attacks add Grudge and lead to powerful skills. Leave the damage to the NPCs.

passives.2.effect.text:
At Stage Start, apply The Book of Vengeance to all Sinners and LCD characters.

If more than three skills hit this turn, gain The Middle - Vengeance Tattoo [Great Brother] next turn equal to the number of skills above three.

passives.2.condition.text: Stage Start; more than three skills hit

passives.2.response.text: Extra attacks grant Great Brother tattoos. NPC attacks also count, so three or fewer Sinner attacks are not necessarily safe.

passives.3.effect.text:
Take 30% less damage from Burn, Bleed, Tremor, and Rupture (rounded down).
Stagger Threshold advancement received is reduced by 50% (rounded down).

passives.3.condition.text: Status damage and Stagger Threshold advancement

passives.3.response.text: Reduces Burn and other status damage. Do not add Counters while trying to rely solely on status damage.

passives.4.effect.text: If Panicked at Turn End, reset SP to 0.

passives.4.response.text: SP returns to 0. Sustaining Panic alone is not a winning plan.

passives.5.effect.text: When gaining a buff that changes Panic Type, Panic Type stays unchanged. Apply the effects intended for targets without SP instead.

passives.5.response.text: Use NPC assignments and assistance rather than relying on changing Panic Type.

passives.6.name.text: Praise is the Wind in Her Sail

passives.6.effect.text:
On Clash Win, gain 1 I Got Praised!

On skill hit, gain 1 I Got Praised! (once per skill; destroyed Coins do not grant it).

If the first skill used this turn wins a clash, gain 1 additional I Got Praised! and give that skill +1 Coin Power.

passives.6.condition.text: Kira's clash wins and hits with undestroyed Coins

passives.6.response.text: More I Got Praised! means more damage. Prevent “Totally Badass Ass-kicking” from reaching its reuse condition.

passives.7.name.text: I'm pretty sure the Middle never forgets

passives.7.effect.text:
After taking damage from skills twice, gain 1 The Middle - Grudge and lose 1 I Got Praised! (damage instances accumulate).

At maximum The Middle - Grudge, use a powerful attack.

At Turn End, if HP is below 80%, 60%, or 40%, gain The Middle - Grudge up to its maximum.

passives.7.condition.text: Two instances of skill damage; HP thresholds

passives.7.response.text: Kira uses her major attack at maximum Grudge. Save skills and healing while lowering her HP.

passives.8.effect.text:
If more than two skills hit this turn, gain The Middle Styled Augmentation Tattoos next turn equal to the number of skills above two.

“Will the Middle accept me as family someday too, so I can live with all the Big Sisters and Brothers forever?”

passives.8.response.text: More attacks mean more tattoos next turn. Restore the HP of Sinners focusing their attacks to prepare for Counter reuses.

passives.9.name.text: Am I doing this right, Papa?!

passives.9.effect.text:
Starts the stage with Thermal Blades OFF.

At Turn Start with at least 3 I Got Praised!, change to Thermal Blades ON for the turn and additionally inflict Burn with skills that inflict Bleed.

At Turn End with fewer than 3 I Got Praised!, change Thermal Blades ON to Thermal Blades OFF.

“Papa's the best. He always praises me and buys me comics.”

passives.9.response.text: Thermal Blades ON adds Burn to Bleed skills. Win clashes to limit on-hit effects.

passives.10.effect.text: If Panicked at Turn End, reset SP to 0.

passives.10.response.text: SP returns to 0. Sustaining Panic alone is not a winning plan.

passives.11.effect.text: When gaining a buff that changes Panic Type, Panic Type stays unchanged. Apply the effects intended for targets without SP instead.

passives.11.response.text: Use NPC assignments and assistance rather than relying on changing Panic Type.

mechanics.0.effect.text: When taking lethal damage while another ally is alive, clear Stagger and fully restore HP. Every ally's remaining Ampule count decreases by 1 simultaneously.

mechanics.0.response.text: Check the remaining count shared by NPCs and Sinners on screen. These are not separate revival counts per character.

mechanics.1.effect.text: Ezra and Vespa intercept unopposed attacks against allies with no Defense Skills equipped.

mechanics.1.response.text: Do not assign clashes to attacks left to assistance, or equip Defense Skills on the targeted Sinner. Check whether the NPC is using assistance that turn too.

mechanics.2.effect.text: Maximum 10. Per stack: Offense Level +1, Defense Level −2, Counter damage +5%. At maximum, damage taken +20%. Consumed by specific skills.

mechanics.2.response.text: Careless Sinner attacks against Matthias trigger more dangerous skills.

mechanics.3.effect.text: Maximum 2; expires at Turn End. Blunt and Envy damage +10%. Enables additional effects on Counters and other skills.

mechanics.3.response.text: While active, hold back attacks against Matthias and leave him to the NPCs.

mechanics.4.effect.text: Maximum 3; expires at Turn End. Blunt and Envy damage +5%. Enables effects such as Counter reuse.

mechanics.4.response.text: While focusing on Kira, maintain HP on Sinners exposed to Counters.

mechanics.5.effect.text: Maximum 10. Base Power +1 per 2 stacks; Slash and Blunt damage +5% per stack. Lose 1 after taking damage from skills twice.

mechanics.5.response.text: Do not add Sinner attacks solely to lower this value; consider the resulting Counters first.

mechanics.6.effect.text: Maximum 10. Base Power +1 per 2 stacks; Slash and Blunt damage +8% per stack. Lose 1 after taking damage from skills twice.

mechanics.6.response.text: Keep winning clashes and focusing on Kira to prevent her reuse condition from being met.

mechanics.7.effect.text: Activates at 3 or more I Got Praised!. Skills that inflict Bleed also inflict Burn.

mechanics.7.response.text: Win clashes to stop the attacks and prepare healing for both Burn and Bleed damage.

mechanics.8.effect.text: When either Middle enemy lands a skill hit, heal 7 SP once per skill.

mechanics.8.response.text: Hits also help maintain enemy SP. Sinners should win against Kira while the NPCs handle Matthias.

mechanics.9.effect.text: Moses's support against Kira: 3 Plus Coin Drop from Turn 2 for five turns.

mechanics.9.response.text: Do not permanently subtract it from enemy base values. Check the active effect and its remaining duration.

warnings.0.text: Matthias uses an ordinary Counter. Avoid triggering it by withholding attacks; it cannot be stopped through a clash win.

warnings.1.text: Additional attacks against Matthias add tattoos based on all skills that hit, including NPC skills. This does not mean three Sinner attacks are safe.

warnings.2.text: Do not equip Defense Skills on targets left to Assist Defense. Check support conditions every turn even after Kira is defeated.

warnings.3.text: Skills, support, and ending conditions differ from the 9-44 rematch. Do not apply its final escort procedure here.

preparation.0.text: Recommended Lv. 60. Yi Sang, Don Quixote, and Hong Lu are the three required Sinners. Prepare a strong opening clash and HP/SP recovery.

preparation.1.text: Pierce damage is effective against Kira. Maintain NPC assistance rather than forcing extra damage against the Nursefather.

roles.0.name.text: Clashes and focused damage against Kira

roles.0.reason.text: Reduce enemy actions while the NPCs handle the Nursefather.

roles.1.reason.text: Recover damage from Unbreakable Coins and ordinary Counters.

roles.2.reason.text: Preserve the conditions: an unopposed attack and no Defense Skills equipped on its target.

messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)9-38「キラ・マティアス（9-38）」: Kira & Matthias (9-38) guide for Limbus Company 9-38. Leave Matthias to Moses, Ezra, and Vespa while the three Sinners focus on Kira. Do not assign Defense Skills or clashes to attacks meant for Assist Defense, and avoid needlessly triggering the Nursefather's Counter.
